excerpt: Here's Wynona Lamborn's diary from December 14 - December 21, 1890. The weather has been stormy and cold - on the edge of rain and snow. Dec. 14. Came from Uncle Franks this morning. They went up to Ollie’s. In P.M. we went to Neal Hambleto

allImages.caption: Neal Hambleton was Uncle Thomas Hambleton's cousin. Thomas Hambleton and his wife, Lib Lamborn, raised Wynona after her father William Lewis Lamborn and her mother, Phebe Barnard, died. Neal was on the board of directors of Quarryville National Bank as well as being a farmer.
